text: Bitcoin's 8.9% surge is outpacing Ethereum's 5.6% gain, reflecting a risk-on mood where traders are rotating toward the largest, most liquid asset while still supporting alts. The Fear & Greed index at 72 with a 43-point weekly jump signals aggressive sentiment recovery, though Bitcoin's rising dominance to 59.3% suggests confidence in macro strength rather than broad-based altcoin enthusiasm. Volume at $146B is elevated but not extreme, indicating solid participation without the frenzied activity that typically precedes major reversals.
